generator_method: Deterministic grammar enumeration + native YAML Marshal->Unmarshal for map[string]any. This is a human-authored generic metamorphic oracle; no issue-specific expected outputs, no contributor PR diff or added tests used.
semantic_invariant: For each valid UTF-8 source string s, unmarshalling the library's YAML encoding of map[string]any{"value": s} must yield string s, or report an explicit unsupported-case error; silent type changes/contents differences are candidates for bugs. This property is internal roundtrip consistency, not complete YAML conformance.
negative_controls: Random source strings only, no lossy normalization permitted; controls include ordinary ASCII, punctuations, and quoted keyword strings.
prior_issue_visibility: The scientific-notation PR #939 issue and prior Go YAML #957 patch were previously read; failures identical to those reports cannot be labeled new. No implementation patch of current target is inspected in this experiment.
mismatch_admission: Only classify native test failures with original source pinned, complete Go test execution, and failing source string captured. Determine whether independent reference agrees; if both fail call invariant/unsupported UNKNOWN, not a goccy bug. If only target fails with reference green, call CANDIDATE and require replay/reduction.
conclusion_cap: Never claim an undisclosed vulnerability, general semantics equivalence, L7 method invention or significant competitive advantage from differential mismatches alone.
